title: Corporate Event & Workshop Venue Capacities
content: For internal customer workshops and corporate training events, venue options are governed by capacity thresholds. Conference Room A supports up to 25 attendees and includes AV equipment. Executive Hall B accommodates up to 100 attendees with stage setup. Main Auditorium C supports up to 300 attendees for multi-track events.

title: Workshop Equipment & Setup Requirements
content: All customer workshop rooms require at least 2 weeks advance booking. Executive Hall B and Main Auditorium C include hybrid streaming equipment, dual whiteboards, and dedicated audio technicians. Additional flipcharts and breakout seating must be reserved 5 business days prior.

title: Event Cancellation & Refund Tier Policy
content: Event cancellations are subject to structured refund timelines. Cancellations made more than 30 days prior to the event date receive a 100% full refund. Cancellations made between 14 and 30 days prior receive a 50% refund.

title: Late Cancellation Penalties & Emergency Forfeiture
content: Cancellations notice provided less than 14 days prior to event commencement will result in 0% refund and full forfeiture of room reservation deposits. Emergency waivers require VP-level written approval.

title: Catering Services & Dietary Compliance
content: Standard event catering options include Continental Breakfast ($20/head), Working Lunch Buffet ($35/head), and Premium Reception ($60/head). All catering packages accommodate vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and kosher dietary requests if specified 72 hours prior.

title: Alcohol Policy & External Vendor Restrictions
content: External food and beverage vendors are strictly prohibited on company premises. Alcohol service is restricted to Premium Reception packages and requires licensed corporate bartending staff with prior HR clearance.

title: Domestic Travel & Accommodations Policy
content: Domestic business travel requires manager approval at least 7 days in advance. Flight bookings must be Economy Class on preferred partner airlines. Hotel accommodation per diem is capped at $250/night in tier-1 cities and $180/night in tier-2 cities.

title: International Travel & Visa Clearance Policy
content: International business travel requires Director-level pre-approval at least 21 days in advance. Premium Economy is permitted for non-stop flights exceeding 8 hours. Travelers must obtain corporate travel insurance and valid visa documentation prior to ticket issuance.

title: Expense Reimbursement & Receipt Guidelines
content: All travel and event expense claims must be submitted via the Concur portal within 14 calendar days post-event. Itemized receipts are mandatory for all expenses exceeding $25. Mileage reimbursement is fixed at $0.67 per mile.
